terms.definition: Being in Education, Employment or Training. The default engaged state: universal, and not tracked individually once things go well.
Child Held in Early years, Education or Training. Held by the state or by someone other than their parents: care, guardianship, treatment, a parent in custody, or licensed work.
Not in Education, Employment or Training. The label used for young people aged 16 to 24 who are none of these.
A period when a child or young person is held by the state or another adult, such as care, guardianship or custody. Some held statuses carry duties up to age 25.
The moment a child or young person leaves oversight or a record breaks, such as leaving care at 18. Published for the NEET and adult portals to pick up.
A departure event as the adult portal receives it: the point at which a young person's story continues in Whole-life 360º.
An adult going back to work, learning or training after time away, for example after raising a family, caring for someone, a sabbatical, illness, custody or military service.
Self-employment or starting a business as a way into work, offered beside jobs, learning and training rather than instead of them.
Universal Credit's test of whether self-employment is your main job, organised and regular, with the aim of making a profit. It decides whether the start-up period and minimum income floor apply.
Up to 12 months on Universal Credit when your actual self-employed earnings are used and the minimum income floor does not apply.
An assumed level of earnings Universal Credit uses for gainfully self-employed people once any start-up period ends, if they earn less than it.
The address a company director gives Companies House for post. It is public, and does not have to be the director's home.
A company's official address. It is public and must be an 'appropriate address' where delivery can be acknowledged; a PO Box is not allowed.
Being on the electoral register without your name or address being shown, for people whose safety would be at risk. It can affect credit checks.
